purpose: Production measurement of the common batched path of measurement/step.c (organizer image and flags) on two input sets (seed 1 and seed 2), at 1, 2, 63 and 64 batch steps; plain = Ir(2)-Ir(1), anchor = Ir(64)-Ir(63), per walk step over 65536 walks. The inputs are the first 132096 lines of the generator output (2^16 adders, 2^16 walks, 1024 spares).
kernel: measurement/step.c: the rare paths out of line, the escape a doubling, the repeat counter a diagnostic

common_path_bound.method: per-instruction Callgrind counts of the production binary at 2, 63 and 64 batch steps with its disassembly: every conditional branch executed once per walk is listed with the instruction count of its other edge
branches_per_walk: first test of the distinguished-point check (key >> 16 = 0): the other edge evaluates the second test, +3 instructions, and rejoins the common path
previous-key filter match: leads to a call of rare_2cycle after 12 instructions (a rare event, charged separately)
anchor filter match: leads to a call of rare_anchor after 10 instructions (a rare event)
trail cap, anchor copy only: leads to new_trail after 11 instructions (an abandonment, a rare event)
distinguished point: leads to dp_restart (a rare event)

unbatched_op_Ir: add_single: 40,878 to 40,890 on the addition paths and 41,183 on the doubling path (41,185 charged); see measurement/forced/summary.json
